dialogue.text: That was a good match, kid. I have to thank you for letting me crash here. It’s much better than the subway floor after missing the last train.
Ah, where are my manners? My name is Naoki Fukuda. Nice to meet you… properly.
I guess it does. Damn, I miss my buddies. Late night karaoke was the best… I really hope they’re doing okay…
Hey, that phone over on those boxes… Is it working?
Oh yes, they’ll definitely find us if we just sit here.
Haha. Seriously though, whenever you’re lost, you should always call emergency services. Especially after an earthquake like this.
Here, take this and dial 119. That will alert emergency services. Call them and tell them we’re here.
We’ll have a better chance of making it out in one piece.
Do this for me, and I’ll give you something. My treat.
